SmartDoc 2015 - Challenge 1 Dataset
Version: 2.0.0

Dataset source: http://smartdoc.univ-lr.fr/
Upstream source: https://github.com/jchazalon/smartdoc15-ch1-pywrapper

Local modifications: None. OpenScaner uses the pinned dataset as training and
validation input without redistributing or modifying the source archive.

The dataset contains smartphone video frames and quadrilateral ground truth
created for the SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1 competition. Please cite:

Jean-Christophe Burie, Joseph Chazalon, Mickael Coustaty, Sebastien Eskenazi,
Muhammad Muzzamil Luqman, Maroua Mehri, Nibal Nayef, Jean-Marc Ogier,
Sophea Prum, and Marcal Rusinol. "ICDAR2015 Competition on Smartphone
Document Capture and OCR (SmartDoc)." 13th International Conference on
Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR), 2015.
